reason: The hypothesis combines the known formation of protective Cr2O3 and spinel oxides on FeCoNiMnCu coatings during long-term thermal exposure (P1, P3) with the observation that a spinel phase improves high-temperature wear resistance in a different HEA (P42). It proposes a new, controlled pre-oxidation intervention to engineer this oxide scale before wear, which is not suggested in any passage. This synthesis of separate findings into a specific processing route for FeNiCrCoCu goes beyond the existing literature.

protective oxide scale enhancing wear resistance at high temperature
